$comment: Single source of truth for the project cards. tools/build_projects.js regenerates projects.html and the home highlights from this file; tools/check_projects.js asserts the committed HTML matches. Versions mirror the tagged GitHub releases.

projects.name: dc-twin
projects.description: A deterministic, capacity-constrained simulator for synthetic data-center electrical architectures.
projects.result: The same inputs and model version always reproduce the same SHA-256 result hash, and the reference scenarios match hand calculations committed independently of the engine.
projects.limitation: Models lossless active power against capacity constraints only — no voltage, frequency, protection, thermal behavior, or economics.
projects.image_alt: dc-twin web explorer showing the timeline, alarms, and metrics of the composite reference scenario

projects.name: Electrical Asset Validator
projects.description: A self-hosted web app that validates CSV and XLSX electrical asset registers and diffs two revisions by stable asset tag.
projects.result: Both file formats go through exactly the same nine-column rule set, and every finding names the row and field it refers to.
projects.limitation: No authentication or multi-tenant isolation; processing is synchronous and bounded, and rules check data quality, not electrical-code compliance.
projects.image_alt: Validation results dashboard with quality score, issue metrics, filters, and row-level findings

projects.name: Critical Facilities Manager
projects.description: An operations and commissioning platform for critical facilities behind a token-authenticated, role-guarded REST API.
projects.result: Mutual-exclusion constraints stop simultaneous maintenance on redundant equipment — the second order is rejected with a 409 naming the constraint and the conflicting order.
projects.limitation: API-token authentication only, with no frontend yet, and roles apply to the whole installation rather than per site.

projects.name: PV-BESS dispatch model
projects.description: A dispatch and investment model for solar-plus-battery plants, solved as a mixed-integer program with HiGHS.
projects.result: Solver benchmarks per horizon are published including the full-year run that did not finish, together with the script that reproduces the attempt.
projects.limitation: Dispatch plus unlevered, pre-tax investment math only — no electrical design, no price forecasting, and no taxes, debt, or grants.
projects.image_alt: Results page with hand-drawn SVG charts of PV production, prices, battery flows, and state of charge

projects.name: Energy Investment Lab
projects.description: A cash-flow and financing model for energy assets, in plain Python with no runtime dependencies.
projects.result: The seeded Monte Carlo is reproducible number for number, and every worked example in the docs is hand-calculated and pinned by tests.
projects.limitation: Sensitivities are one-at-a-time single-parameter variants, and nothing it produces is investment advice.

projects.name: Quant Risk Engine
projects.description: A reproducible portfolio-analytics and market-risk engine for public securities — deliberately not a prediction tool.
projects.result: The backtest interface exposes only observations strictly preceding the decision date, and a deliberately cheating policy in the tests prices what peeking would be worth.
projects.limitation: Measures what a supplied price history did, under stated conventions — it forecasts nothing and recommends nothing.
tech: NumPy and SciPy as the only runtime dependencies

projects.name: Sudoku Instant
projects.description: A sudoku game as an installable progressive web app with six difficulty levels, offline play, and full keyboard support.
projects.result: All 24 puzzles are confirmed by a bounded solver to have exactly one solution, and Playwright plays the app through on desktop and mobile viewports.
projects.limitation: Difficulty is approximated by clue count rather than rated solving techniques, and progress lives in one browser profile with no sync.
projects.image_alt: Sudoku Instant gameplay on a mobile viewport with the grid, timer, and number pad
